loss: Var(HHI/10000) + 0.1 × mean Var(top-three cluster membership by observed record). Expected reduction after an oracle pair answer. Weights fixed before evaluation.
limitations: Identifier equality is a proxy for legal-entity identity, not adjudicated ownership or misconduct.
Repeated simulation seeds quantify Monte Carlo/review-order variation, not a population confidence interval.
Composite-likelihood scenario weights are not calibrated partition probabilities.
Candidate edges require calibrated score >= 0.05; disconnected and oversized components stay separate, so support misses can leave irreducible error.
Review queries are simulated oracle responses, not human adjudication; equal pair budgets do not measure equal human time.
